info.name: 推荐查询持久回归
info.description: 所有用例已加入SmartRecruit API - Optimized Regression / 03 Job。仅隔离端口18091；全部业务请求只读；夹具数据由受保护的本地脚本建立。

item.name: 003 获取推荐选项与默认规则

exec: const b=pm.response.json();pm.test('HTTP200与业务200',()=>{pm.expect(pm.response.code).eq(200);pm.expect(b.code).eq(200);});pm.test("选项不含演示默认偏好",()=>{pm.expect(b.data.defaultExcludeApplied).eq(true);pm.expect(b.data.defaultExcludeExpired).eq(true);pm.expect(b.data.defaultStrictCity).eq(false);pm.expect(b.data.semanticEnabled).eq(false);pm.expect(b.data.salaryUnit).eq('元/月');pm.expect(b.data.directions.map(x=>x.code)).deep.eq(['BACKEND','FRONTEND']);pm.expect(b.data.presets).lengthOf(3);pm.expect(b.data.presets[0].weights.SKILL).eq(35);pm.expect(b.data.cities.some(x=>x.code==='XIAN')).eq(true);pm.expect(b.data.versions.embeddingModelVersion).eq(null);});

item.name: 004 获取所选简历默认上下文

exec: const b=pm.response.json();pm.test('HTTP200与业务200',()=>{pm.expect(pm.response.code).eq(200);pm.expect(b.code).eq(200);});pm.test("来自真实所选简历",()=>{pm.expect(b.data.resumeId).eq(901);pm.expect(b.data.preferences.directionCode).eq('BACKEND');pm.expect(b.data.preferences.cityCode).eq('SHANGHAI');pm.expect(b.data.preferences.salaryMax).eq(20000);pm.expect(b.data.actualFormalMonths).eq(0);pm.expect(b.data.highestEducation).eq('BACHELOR');pm.expect(b.data.skills).lengthOf(3);pm.expect(b.data.asOfDate).eq(pm.environment.get('rqAsOfDate'));pm.expect(b.data).not.have.property('phone');pm.expect(b.data).not.have.property('email');});pm.collectionVariables.set('rqDefaultContext',JSON.stringify(b.data));

item.name: 005 默认分页无需演示偏好

exec: const b=pm.response.json();pm.test('HTTP200与业务200',()=>{pm.expect(pm.response.code).eq(200);pm.expect(b.code).eq(200);});pm.test("默认分页和总数",()=>{pm.expect(b.data.page).eq(1);pm.expect(b.data.size).eq(10);pm.expect(b.data.items).lengthOf(10);pm.expect(b.data.total).eq(19);pm.expect(b.data.excludeApplied).eq(true);pm.expect(b.data.excludeExpired).eq(true);pm.expect(b.data.items[0].jobId).eq(1999);});

item.name: 006 全局推荐资格过滤与可解释分数

exec: const b=pm.response.json();pm.test('HTTP200与业务200',()=>{pm.expect(pm.response.code).eq(200);pm.expect(b.code).eq(200);});pm.test("全局结果与手算",()=>{pm.expect(b.data.total).eq(19);pm.expect(b.data.items).lengthOf(19);const ids=b.data.items.map(x=>x.jobId);for(const id of [1009,1011,1012,1013,1014,1015,1016,1017,1018,1019,1021])pm.expect(ids).not.include(id);pm.expect(b.data.items[0].jobId).eq(1999);pm.expect(b.data.items.find(x=>x.jobId===1002).totalScore).eq(70.5);pm.expect(b.data.items.find(x=>x.jobId===1003).totalScore).eq(69);pm.expect(b.data.items.find(x=>x.jobId===1004).totalScore).eq(51.75);pm.expect(b.data.items.find(x=>x.jobId===1003).excludedWeight).eq(25);pm.expect(b.data.items.find(x=>x.jobId===1004).dataCoverage).eq(75);pm.expect(b.data.items.every(x=>x.applied===false&&x.expired===false)).eq(true);pm.expect(b.data.items.every(x=>x.companyId===201)).eq(true);pm.expect(b.data.items.find(x=>x.jobId===1002).applied).eq(false);pm.expect(b.data.items.at(-1).totalScore).eq(null);pm.expect(b.data.items[0]).not.have.property('unroundedScore');});pm.collectionVariables.set('rqFullIds',JSON.stringify(b.data.items.map(x=>x.jobId)));pm.test("来源版本与逐项证据",()=>{const x=b.data.items.find(x=>x.jobId===1022);pm.expect(x.requiredAbilitiesSource).eq('STRUCTURED');pm.expect(x.requiredAbilitiesVersion).eq(7);pm.expect(x.abilityMatches).lengthOf(2);pm.expect(x.abilityMatches[0].requirements).lengthOf(2);pm.expect(x.abilityMatches[0].candidateEvidence.rawText).eq('Java');pm.expect(x.totalScore).eq(82.5);});

item.name: 007 三种状态与空能力不可回退

exec: const b=pm.response.json();pm.test('HTTP200与业务200',()=>{pm.expect(pm.response.code).eq(200);pm.expect(b.code).eq(200);});pm.test("UNKNOWN和不可比较",()=>{pm.expect(b.data.items.find(x=>x.jobId===1002).dimensions.find(x=>x.dimension==='EDUCATION').score).eq(0);pm.expect(b.data.items.find(x=>x.jobId===1002).dimensions.find(x=>x.dimension==='EDUCATION').meetsRequirement).eq(false);pm.expect(b.data.items.find(x=>x.jobId===1003).dimensions.find(x=>x.dimension==='SALARY').state).eq('NOT_APPLICABLE');pm.expect(b.data.items.find(x=>x.jobId===1004).dimensions.find(x=>x.dimension==='SALARY').state).eq('UNKNOWN');pm.expect(b.data.items.find(x=>x.jobId===1004).dimensions.find(x=>x.dimension==='SALARY').effectiveWeightRatio).eq(0.25);for(const id of [1005,1006,1007]){const x=b.data.items.find(x=>x.jobId===id);pm.expect(x.totalScore).eq(null);pm.expect(x.scoreReason).eq('CORE_SKILLS_UNKNOWN');}pm.expect(b.data.items.find(x=>x.jobId===1007).abilityMatches[0].reason).eq('SEMANTIC_NOT_CONFIGURED');pm.expect(b.data.items.find(x=>x.jobId===1006).abilityMatches).deep.eq([]);});

item.name: 008 默认排除截止但截止当天保留
009 关闭已投递排除按用户而非简历判断

exec: const b=pm.response.json();pm.test('HTTP200与业务200',()=>{pm.expect(pm.response.code).eq(200);pm.expect(b.code).eq(200);});pm.test("已拒绝及其它简历投递仍标记",()=>{pm.expect(b.data.total).eq(20);pm.expect(b.data.items.find(x=>x.jobId===1011).applied).eq(true);pm.expect(b.data.items.some(x=>x.jobId===1012)).eq(false);});

item.name: 010 关闭过期排除但继续排除已投递
011 同时关闭两个排除开关

exec: const b=pm.response.json();pm.test('HTTP200与业务200',()=>{pm.expect(pm.response.code).eq(200);pm.expect(b.code).eq(200);});pm.test("全部可选历史",()=>{pm.expect(b.data.total).eq(22);const x=b.data.items.find(x=>x.jobId===1012);pm.expect(x.applied).eq(true);pm.expect(x.expired).eq(true);for(const id of [1013,1014,1015,1016,1017])pm.expect(b.data.items.map(x=>x.jobId)).not.include(id);});

item.name: 012 严格城市识别英文与中文别名

const b=pm.response.json();pm.test('HTTP200与业务200',()=>{pm.expect(pm.response.code).eq(200);pm.expect(b.code).eq(200);});pm.test("与全局切片一致",()=>{pm.expect(b.data.items.map(x=>x.jobId)).deep.eq(JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('rqFullIds')).slice(3,6));});

exec: const b=pm.response.json();pm.test('HTTP200与业务200',()=>{pm.expect(pm.response.code).eq(200);pm.expect(b.code).eq(200);});pm.test("本次未知保留权重",()=>{pm.expect(b.data.appliedPreferences.city).eq(null);pm.expect(b.data.appliedPreferences.salaryMax).eq(null);pm.expect(b.data.items.find(x=>x.jobId===1002).dimensions.find(x=>x.dimension==='CITY').state).eq('UNKNOWN');pm.expect(b.data.items.find(x=>x.jobId===1002).dimensions.find(x=>x.dimension==='SALARY').state).eq('UNKNOWN');});

item.name: 115 同时查询不产生共享可变状态

exec: const b=pm.response.json();pm.test('HTTP200与业务200',()=>{pm.expect(pm.response.code).eq(200);pm.expect(b.code).eq(200);});let done=0;const values=[];for(let i=0;i<2;i++)pm.sendRequest({url:pm.environment.get('rqHost')+'/job/recommendations',method:'POST',header:{Authorization:'Bearer '+pm.collectionVariables.get('rqToken1'),'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:{mode:'raw',raw:JSON.stringify({resumeId:901,size:100})}},(err,res)=>{pm.test('并发只读请求成功',()=>{pm.expect(err).eq(null);pm.expect(res.code).eq(200);pm.expect(res.json().code).eq(200);});if(!err)values.push(res.json().data);if(++done===2)pm.test('并发结果一致',()=>pm.expect(values[0]).deep.eq(values[1]));});
